title: Fragmented World
description:
Fragmented World is a new single-player experience where you'll need to use the skill of perspective-shifting to reassemble a world that has become fragmented. On one hand, you will explore the world and interact with it in first person. However, to solve the fragmented worlds, you'll need to see it from another perspective by switching to an isometric view from which you can modify the world in order to unite it and reach your goal.Embark on an unpredictable and daunting journeyThe world of Fragmented World will constantly challenge you and encourage you to give up and leave it all behind. Will you push forward despite everything or will you surrender? It's all up to you. Your choices and interactions will impact the game in which you are the protagonist.

• Employ the unique mechanic of perspective shifting to manipulate the fragmented world.

• Challenging levels where you must unite fragments based on their colors. It will become increasingly complex, adding more elements to consider.

• To successfully complete each level, you must achieve the reconnection of the necessary energy in that area.

• Depending on the fear you choose at the beginning of the game, the cutscenes and enemies you encounter will adapt to that fear.

• Intermediate levels after a certain number of connected puzzles. These levels focus on the narrative, and to overcome them, you must think differently than usual. Nothing is as it seems, and it appears that someone doesn't want you to progress.

• Colorblind mode. This mode makes symbols visible on each fragment for identification, eliminating the reliance on colors.

• Dark, harsh, and personal story with multiple mysteries. Everything is against you. But perhaps you are the right person to finally fix it by delving into the world of Fragmented World
description_short: Reconnect a fragmented world by switching between two perspectives – one for exploration and another for manipulating the fragmented world. Overcome intermediate levels where you'll need to employ lateral thinking and make decisions. Can you once again unite a decadent and broken world?
